changelog:
- Major update to guidelines: now focuses on structural AI tells, not just surface phrases.
- Replaces rule list with principles for identifying and fixing deep "AI smell" (overly tidy arcs, morals, fake closure, etc.).
- Adds explicit boundaries for when to apply the skill (public, personal-voice writing) and when not to.
- Lists new hard bans (no "less like X, more like Y", no sermon endings, etc.).
- Readme and license files added; anti-AI patterns reference replaced with new guide.
- Updates review and rewrite process with more precise, human-centered steps.
summary: Draft or review writing to avoid structural AI tells and preserve a rough human voice.
